text: Program Description 1. Program Introduction Editor Notes: Graduated are well equipped with professional skills and well informed about Chinese language,culture,economy, as well as its people. This program cultivates students with fundamental principles and essentials about civil engineering aiming to train practical engineers with skills and innovation. Students are equipped with basic skills, ability to conduct project planning and potential to engage in R & D. Graduates can work as technicians or managers in designing, construction, management, investment and R & D department of relevant areas. 2. The Model of the Program Editor Notes: The model of this program is 2+2. It takes 4 years to complete this program generally; however it can be extended to 6 years at most. In the first two years the courses are delivered in English while in the last two years international students take classes with Chinese peers for Chinese-medium courses. This model can achieve kill-two-birds with one stone effect. On the one hand, students can start their major directly after they come to China. On the other hand, students have more time to learn Chinese before they actually need to study in Chinese. 3. The Model of the Program Editor Notes: This program provides internship, students can choose at the right time. Students can have up to one-semester internship in companies under the guidance of professors. 4. Free-Chinese lessons Editor Notes: Although this program is taught by English, international students can still take Chinese courses for free. When students are on their degree program, they can still take Chinese lessons free of charge. 5. Introduction of Zhejiang A & F University Editor Notes: The first employment rate of undergraduate students is always more than 90% and in the forefront of Zhejiang universities. Founded in 1958, Zhejiang A & F University (ZAFU) is a comprehensive university directly under the auspices of Zhejiang Province offering Bachelor and Masters degrees in agriculture, technology, science, literature, management, law, economics, medicine, etc. and enrolling international students. ZAFU, located in Lin'an City (west of the popular tourist destination Hangzhou) has Yijin and East Lake campuses covering almost 167 hectares with 550,000 square meters of building space. Its modern buildings and facilities in a setting of great natural beauty, surrounded by mountains and water, make ZAFU a most suitable place for learning, teaching, and conducting research. The campus combined with the botanical garden comprise an ecological environment with functions of teaching, scientific research, and biodiversity conservation. Learn More>> 6.
